summary: macOS 26 (bash 3.2, BSD sed): 'fledge run musl-install-test' (bash .github/scripts/test-install-musl-tools.sh) passed all 7 cases: x86_64 apt-mirrors.txt deb822, arm64 ports deb822 and jammy one-line sources with the runner mirror unresolvable each install musl-tools through the fallback list; healthy mirror leaves sources untouched; every mirror dead and no repointable source both end in ::error::; ci.yml runs the script.
